---
title: "01_load"
format: html
---

Library

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("fs")
```

Ensure the raw data directory exists locally

```{r}
dir_create("../data/_raw")
dir_create("../data")
```

Define the online URL

```{r}
data_url <- "https://vincentarelbundock.github.io/Rdatasets/csv/CardioDataSets/mriCardioVars_tbl_df.csv"
```

Download the raw file into local data/\_raw/ folder

```{r}
raw_file_path <- "../data/_raw/mriCardioVars_tbl_df.csv"
download.file(url = data_url, destfile = raw_file_path, mode = "wb")
```

Read the raw data

```{r}
raw_data <- read_csv(file = raw_file_path)
```

Process and save it as 01_dat_load.tsv file

```{r}
write_tsv(x = raw_data, file = "../data/01_dat_load.tsv")
```
